description: This file defines the AzureQueueStreamProviderBuilder class, which implements configuration logic for Azure Queue Storage streaming in Orleans. It includes methods to configure silo and client builders with Azure Queue settings, and a private method to build options based on configuration sections.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring Azure Queue Storage streaming in Orleans, implementing both silo and client builder interfaces.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder with Azure Queue streams using provided configuration.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder)
methods.description: Configures the client builder with Azure Queue streams using provided configuration.

methods.name: GetQueueOptionBuilder
methods.description: Creates an options configuration action for AzureQueueOptions based on the provided configuration section.
